title: Operations and reliability
outcomes: an operational readiness review naming objectives, signals, on-call, runbooks, rollback, and capacity
a blameless postmortem with timeline, contributing factors, and actions with owners
inputs: the service, change, or incident under review
monitoring, alerting, and incident sources the project declares
the confirmed risk posture and review cadence
minimumEvidence: every objective, alert, and capacity claim cites a dashboard, config, runbook, or incident record; a runbook nobody has run is marked untested
escalation: a change with no rollback and no way to notice failure is reported as not ready, whatever the launch date
an incident with a security or privacy dimension is handed to security-privacy before the postmortem is closed
